purpose: Merged, classified inventory of every reference from every consumer into nix-config, so the config/ai -> config/fleet rename (#47) and its straggler sweep (#63) know exactly who breaks. One record per reference.
consumerLayout: nix-config at the repository root; consumer checkouts as siblings (nixos, vps, andoria). Absolute paths are intentionally omitted: see the comment at this key in test/bin/consumer-inventory.

classificationScheme.rename-now: Stale operational reference to the literal config/ai directory inside nix-config; #47 must leave none.
classificationScheme.stub-covered: External consumer edge still resolving through stale ?dir=config/ai. #47's throwing stub makes this fail loudly; migrate the URL in the authorized coordinated transaction.
classificationScheme.retire: Unsupported compatibility paths: consumer reach-ins into nix-config internal overlays, plus any reintroduced flake-ai.nix import. Delete reach-ins after typed config/fleet migration; flake-ai.nix references are immediate regressions.
classificationScheme.retain-with-owner: Keep as-is with owner + retirement trigger: the supported config/*.nix portable surface, root flake=false nix-config inputs, and the ai-nix/node-red compatibility surfaces (EPIC 7).

derivation.internalConfigAiRefs: git -C <repo_root> ls-files -z | select tracked * paths; grep -I -n -F -e 'config/ai' <existing-tracked-files>
derivation.internalConfigAiFiles: derive unique file names from internalConfigAiRefs
derivation.flakeAiInternalConsumers: reuse git-ls-files-scoped tracked paths; grep -In -E -e 'flake-ai\.nix' <existing-tracked-files>  # keep .nix, non-comment, path-import lines
derivation.consumerInputs: parse <consumer>/flake.lock for nodes referencing nix-config (dir='' repo-root input, dir='config/ai' stale or dir='config/fleet' canonical subflake input); locate each url="...nix-config..." line in <consumer>/flake.nix
derivation.consumerReachins: scan every tracked *.nix under <consumer>/ (filesystem fallback if non-Git) for '${inputs.nix-config}/PATH' interpolations, for 'inherit (import "${inputs.nix-config}/...") ATTR ;' cherry-picks, and for 'inputs.nix-config-ai.overlays' uses
